column1: # Iliad - Part 1.5 — naskah 28 (M23028): pertempuran puncak di The Elmo melawan Ateraxis; Anjelie menembakkan senjata rahasia.
# Tetap Inggris: Ateraxis, Graurizard, Jojo, Juno, Sharkry, Sextans, OTs-14, Groza,
# Krolik, Sakura, Lewis, Sabrina, Voymastina, Nemesis, Elif, Helena, Melanie, Helen,
# Mayling, Colphne, Anjelie, Caldwell, Boojum, Remolding Pattern, Neural cloud, Frame,
# The Elmo, Mokosh, URNC, Collapse Piece, Collapse Storm, Yellow Zone, Doll.
("Ding! Ding ding! Ding ding ding ding—!")
column2: ("Ting! Ting ting! Ting ting ting ting—!")

column1: (A dense barrage poured down from all directions, hitting the colorless barrier in front of Ateraxis, stirring up continuous crisp sounds.)
column2: (Hujan tembakan yang rapat mengucur dari segala arah, menghantam penghalang tak berwarna di depan Ateraxis, menimbulkan bunyi nyaring bertubi-tubi.)

column1: (The blanket bombing just organized by Sharkry almost completely engulfed her position.)
column2: (Pengeboman menyeluruh yang baru saja disusun Sharkry nyaris menelan seluruh posisinya.)

column1: (But when the swirling smoke and dust finally dispersed, the girl was still standing quietly in place.)
column2: (Tapi saat asap dan debu yang berpusar itu akhirnya sirna, gadis itu masih berdiri diam di tempatnya.)

column1: (Without a single scratch, not even a strand of the hair falling over her shoulders was slightly out of place.)
column2: (Tanpa satu goresan pun, bahkan sehelai rambut yang jatuh di bahunya pun tidak bergeser sedikit.)

column1: (Like an elegant noble lady, she landed gracefully on the deck of the Elmo and walked towards the entrance they were guarding.)
column2: (Bagai bangsawan yang anggun, dia mendarat dengan luwes di geladak Elmo dan melangkah ke arah pintu masuk yang mereka jaga.)

column1: (The fierce wind howled in her ears, and the sandstorm kicked up by the Collapse Storm made it almost impossible for her to see the enemy in front of her.)
column2: (Angin ganas meraung di telinganya, dan badai pasir yang diterbangkan Collapse Storm membuatnya nyaris tak bisa melihat musuh di depannya.)

column1: ...You guys are really working hard.
column2: ...Kalian benar-benar bekerja keras.

column1: Commander... next, let me be a little serious too.
column2: Komandan... berikutnya, izinkan aku sedikit serius juga.

column1: (The tissue on her arm began some kind of weird wriggling again—in the next instant, a long blade materialized among the sticky Boojum tissue, and with a whistling sound tearing through the air, slashed straight at Sextans standing at the very front.)
column2: (Jaringan di lengannya kembali menggeliat aneh—sesaat kemudian, sebilah pedang panjang terbentuk di antara jaringan Boojum yang lengket itu, dan dengan siulan yang merobek udara, menebas lurus ke arah Sextans yang berdiri paling depan.)

column1: Long time no see, you look very happy—I'm still learning, but does this sound like something said to a "sister-in-law"?
column2: Lama tidak bertemu, kau kelihatan bahagia sekali—aku masih belajar, tapi apa ini terdengar seperti ucapan pada seorang "ipar"?

column1: It's truly my honor, "sister"—!
column2: Sungguh suatu kehormatan, "Kakak"—!

column1: Then is he good to you?
column2: Lalu, apa dia baik padamu?

column1: What's a kid asking so many questions for?!
column2: Anak kecil kok banyak tanya?!

column1: (Blades crossed for less than a few seconds. Ateraxis's speed far surpassed her opponent's, and she completely sealed off every variation of Sextans's moves. However, empowered by the Remolding Pattern's energy, Sextans continuously pushed her limits, blocking Ateraxis's sword strikes and holding out until OTs-14 circled behind Ateraxis. The two Dolls simultaneously blocked Ateraxis with bullets and melee combat to create more opportunities for the other Dolls.)
column2: (Bilah beradu tak sampai beberapa detik. Kecepatan Ateraxis jauh melampaui lawannya, dan dia menutup rapat setiap variasi gerakan Sextans. Namun didorong energi Remolding Pattern, Sextans terus menembus batasnya, menahan tebasan pedang Ateraxis dan bertahan sampai OTs-14 memutar ke belakangnya. Kedua Doll itu serentak menahan Ateraxis dengan peluru dan pertarungan jarak dekat untuk menciptakan lebih banyak peluang bagi Doll lainnya.)

column1: I've already grown up.
column2: Aku sudah besar.

column1: (Simultaneous with the voice was a loud crash and a muffled groan from Sextans. Ateraxis stepped forward, snapping Sextans's calf, then immediately kicked her away. Her long blade instantly fell towards OTs-14.)
column2: (Bersamaan dengan suara itu terdengar benturan keras dan erangan tertahan dari Sextans. Ateraxis melangkah maju, mematahkan betis Sextans, lalu langsung menendangnya menjauh. Pedang panjangnya seketika turun menebas ke arah OTs-14.)

column1: Tsk—!
column2: Cih—!

column1: Look out!
column2: Awas!

column1: (Although reacting in time, a crimson Boojum arm was still cut off and fell to the ground. Groza's close-range shot with a grenade amplified by the Remolding Pattern made Ateraxis pause for a moment, and she helped OTs-14 up.)
column2: (Meski sempat bereaksi tepat waktu, sebuah lengan Boojum merah tua tetap terpotong dan jatuh ke tanah. Tembakan jarak dekat Groza dengan granat yang diperkuat Remolding Pattern membuat Ateraxis terhenti sejenak, dan dia membantu OTs-14 berdiri.)

column1: (The Dolls covered the two as they retreated.)
column2: (Para Doll melindungi keduanya saat mundur.)

column1: (Ateraxis expressionlessly stepped over the severed arm on the ground and walked towards the military formation lined up by the Dolls.)
column2: (Tanpa ekspresi Ateraxis melangkahi lengan terpotong di tanah itu dan berjalan ke arah formasi tempur yang disusun para Doll.)

column1: ...Big Sis Juno.
column2: ...Kak Juno.

column1: ...Don't call me by that name.
column2: ...Jangan panggil aku dengan nama itu.

column1: Why?
column2: Kenapa?

column1: That is a very beautiful name that belongs to you.
column2: Itu nama yang sangat indah dan itu milikmu.

column1: (Ateraxis stopped and looked at OTs-14—the existence that once shared the same origin as her, but personally cut that line.)
column2: (Ateraxis berhenti dan menatap OTs-14—sosok yang dulu berasal dari akar yang sama dengannya, tapi memutus tali itu dengan tangannya sendiri.)

column1: (She saw what was deep in the other's eyes.)
column2: (Dia melihat apa yang ada jauh di dalam mata orang itu.)

column1: (That is... something she had just seen in the eyes of other Dolls as well.)
column2: (Itu... sesuatu yang baru saja dia lihat juga di mata para Doll lainnya.)

column1: I understand your love and loyalty to the Commander...
column2: Aku paham cinta dan kesetiaanmu pada Komandan...

column1: What I don't quite understand is your attachment to your old "self".
column2: Yang kurang kupahami adalah kelekatanmu pada "dirimu" yang lama.

column1: You have already "updated" into a more outstanding individual, gained stronger power and new possibilities, so why are you still attached to your weak past? Admitting that you are Juno, an individual superior to them, would also be more convenient for the Commander, right?
column2: Kau sudah "diperbarui" menjadi individu yang lebih unggul, mendapat kekuatan yang lebih besar dan kemungkinan yang baru, jadi kenapa masih melekat pada masa lalumu yang lemah? Mengakui bahwa kau adalah Juno, individu yang lebih tinggi daripada mereka, juga akan lebih memudahkan Komandan, kan?

column1: What a pity, Sextans was right, you only know a world centered around yourself.
column2: Sayang sekali, Sextans benar, kau cuma mengenal dunia yang berpusat pada dirimu sendiri.

column1: Whether it's the third-generation Dolls or you, you're all just children who have been given immense power—the adult world is not something you can understand!
column2: Entah Doll generasi ketiga maupun kau, kalian semua cuma anak-anak yang diberi kekuatan luar biasa—dunia orang dewasa bukan sesuatu yang bisa kalian pahami!

column1: ...Curious.
column2: ...Menarik.

column1: However, I'm in a hurry.
column2: Tapi aku sedang buru-buru.

column1: (The Dolls raise their guns and fiercely open fire at the girl in front of them.)
column2: (Para Doll mengangkat senjata dan menembak ganas ke arah gadis di depan mereka.)

column1: (But Ateraxis does not continue to attack the two. She merely sheathes her long blade and walks forward step by step—)
column2: (Tapi Ateraxis tidak melanjutkan serangannya pada keduanya. Dia hanya menyarungkan pedang panjangnya dan melangkah maju setapak demi setapak—)

column1: (Though she walks slowly, the closer she is to her wish being fulfilled, the less eager she becomes.)
column2: (Meski langkahnya lambat, makin dekat keinginannya terwujud, makin surut pula rasa tergesanya.)

column1: (She looked at the Dolls around her constantly shooting at her, and a faint ripple rose in her heart.)
column2: (Dia menatap para Doll di sekelilingnya yang terus menembakinya, dan riak samar muncul di hatinya.)

column1: (It was neither pity nor contempt.)
column2: (Itu bukan rasa kasihan, bukan pula rasa hina.)

column1: (But rather—)
column2: (Melainkan—)

column1: (It was like the complex feeling one gets when stopping at dusk, watching a group of moths dive into a candle flame without hesitation.)
column2: (Itu seperti perasaan rumit saat berhenti di senja hari, menonton sekawanan ngengat menerjun ke nyala lilin tanpa ragu.)

column1: (They could have flown elsewhere, but they insisted on choosing this path.)
column2: (Mereka bisa saja terbang ke tempat lain, tapi mereka bersikeras memilih jalan itu.)

column1: (How... vivid.)
column2: (Betapa... hidupnya.)

column1: Krolik, are you not done yet!
column2: Krolik, kau belum selesai juga!

column1: She said to wait a little longer!
column2: Katanya tunggu sebentar lagi!

column1: (Ateraxis continued moving forward.)
column2: (Ateraxis terus melangkah maju.)

column1: (She had no idea what these Dolls were setting up.)
column2: (Dia sama sekali tidak tahu apa yang sedang disiapkan para Doll itu.)

column1: (Although every gunshot they fired and every move they made was within her grasp, precisely because of this, she couldn't understand what their many meaningless actions were for.)
column2: (Meski setiap tembakan dan setiap gerakan mereka ada dalam genggamannya, justru karena itulah dia tidak paham untuk apa begitu banyak tindakan mereka yang tak bermakna.)

column1: (She didn't understand, but she didn't intend to expose it, nor did she intervene to stop it.)
column2: (Dia tidak paham, tapi dia tidak berniat membongkarnya, tidak pula ikut campur menghentikannya.)

column1: (Just like watching a play being performed, revealing the answer in advance would be too much of a pity.)
column2: (Seperti menonton sandiwara yang sedang dimainkan, membocorkan jawabannya lebih awal akan sangat disayangkan.)

column1: Captain, Nemesis says it's ready!
column2: Kapten, Nemesis bilang sudah siap!

column1: (Just as Krolik's communication rang in Groza's ear, the dragon, which was also being swept by gunfire, roared and descended over Ateraxis toward the Dolls' frontline like an airborne grim reaper, crushing their defensive line.)
column2: (Tepat saat komunikasi Krolik berdering di telinga Groza, sang naga yang juga tersapu tembakan itu mengaum dan turun melewati Ateraxis ke arah garis depan para Doll bagai malaikat maut dari udara, menggilas garis pertahanan mereka.)

column1: (But Ateraxis finally realized that the enemy had been waiting for this exact moment.)
column2: (Tapi Ateraxis akhirnya sadar bahwa musuh memang menunggu momen ini.)

column1: Jojo, get back—
column2: Jojo, mundur—

column1: Everyone, activate Remolding Patterns!
column2: Semuanya, aktifkan Remolding Pattern!

column1: Reel in the net!
column2: Tarik jaringnya!

column1: ("Pfft—" "Bang—")
column2: ("Cras—" "Blam—")

column1: (Accompanied by the popping sound of high-pressure gas, Ateraxis hears Graurizard's roar. It isn't in pain, but rather confused and angry.)
column2: (Diiringi letupan gas bertekanan tinggi, Ateraxis mendengar raungan Graurizard. Itu bukan raungan kesakitan, melainkan raungan bingung sekaligus murka.)

column1: (A giant net made of cables surrounds the dragon on all sides, binding it in place.)
column2: (Jaring raksasa dari kabel mengurung sang naga dari segala sisi, mengikatnya di tempat.)

column1: (At the same time, the space in front of her was instantly filled with some thick and pungent smoke.)
column2: (Di saat bersamaan, ruang di depannya seketika dipenuhi asap tebal yang menyengat.)

column1: Ehehe~ Caught you!
column2: Ehehe~ Kena kau!

column1: (Through the smoke, Ateraxis saw the netted Graurizard angrily begin to struggle. The other party had obviously prepared this method long ago, and this was something no one would think of on an ordinary battlefield—obviously, since that battle in the old castle, the other party had been preparing strategies against the giant dragon.)
column2: (Menembus asap, Ateraxis melihat Graurizard yang terjaring mulai meronta marah. Pihak lawan jelas sudah lama menyiapkan cara ini, dan ini bukan sesuatu yang terpikirkan di medan tempur biasa—jelas sekali, sejak pertempuran di kastil tua itu, lawan sudah menyiapkan strategi melawan naga raksasa itu.)

column1: (If it weren't for the injuries caused by Voymastina, perhaps Graurizard could have broken free quickly, but at this moment, it could only be miserably trapped tighter and tighter.)
column2: (Kalau bukan karena luka-luka akibat Voymastina, mungkin Graurizard bisa cepat melepaskan diri, tapi saat ini dia hanya bisa terjerat makin erat dengan menyedihkan.)

column1: If you're injured... there's really no helping it.
column2: Kalau kau terluka... memang tidak bisa diapa-apakan.

column1: (Naturally, Ateraxis landed beside the giant dragon and cleaved open the net binding her.)
column2: (Dengan wajar Ateraxis mendarat di sisi naga raksasa itu dan membelah jaring yang mengikatnya.)

column1: (And at the moment she raised her blade, she suddenly had an epiphany—)
column2: (Dan tepat saat mengangkat bilahnya, dia tiba-tiba tersadar—)

column1: (That Doll, 'Mother's' first creation, can do more than just this. Since she could know Graurizard's landing point, she naturally could foresee her own actions as well.)
column2: (Doll itu, ciptaan pertama 'Ibu', bisa berbuat lebih dari sekadar ini. Karena dia bisa mengetahui titik pendaratan Graurizard, tentu dia juga bisa meramalkan tindakannya sendiri.)

column1: Even Jojo was just bait?
column2: Jojo pun cuma umpan?

column1: And a trap—
column2: Dan ini jebakan—

column1: (As she takes the next step, her gaze sweeps through the Dolls, catching sight of a beautiful purple silhouette.)
column2: (Saat melangkah berikutnya, pandangannya menyapu para Doll, dan menangkap sesosok siluet ungu yang cantik.)

column1: (At the same time, Ateraxis feels a sensation akin to pain like never before.)
column2: (Di saat bersamaan, Ateraxis merasakan sensasi menyerupai rasa sakit yang belum pernah dia alami.)

column1: (She suddenly realized that the weak yet resolute person, who always forged a path forward in desperate situations, couldn't possibly do something so monotonous, and wouldn't let his beloved Dolls die meaninglessly.)
column2: (Dia mendadak sadar bahwa orang yang lemah namun teguh itu, yang selalu membuka jalan di situasi tanpa harapan, mustahil melakukan sesuatu yang semonoton itu, dan tidak akan membiarkan Doll-Doll kesayangannya mati sia-sia.)

column1: That's...
column2: Itu...

column1: (Not only her, but Graurizard behind her also let out a roar. The wounds left on its body from previous battles were further torn open, and even the Boojum tissue was ripped out.)
column2: (Bukan hanya dia, Graurizard di belakangnya pun mengaum. Luka-luka di tubuhnya dari pertempuran sebelumnya makin tercabik terbuka, bahkan jaringan Boojum-nya ikut terkoyak keluar.)

column1: (For the first time since their creation, the Boojum cells in her body were uncontrollably disintegrating. Although she avoided losing her composure with powerful restraint, Ateraxis still struggled with dizziness for a few seconds.)
column2: (Untuk pertama kalinya sejak mereka diciptakan, sel Boojum di tubuhnya luruh tanpa bisa dikendalikan. Meski dia berhasil menahan diri agar tidak kehilangan ketenangan, Ateraxis tetap bergulat dengan pusing selama beberapa detik.)

column1: (Then she noticed the two petite girls behind the purple Doll.)
column2: (Lalu dia menyadari dua gadis mungil di belakang Doll berbaju ungu itu.)

column1: Helena, be careful!
column2: Helena, hati-hati!

column1: Big sister, protect, little sister! And everyone!
column2: Kakak, lindungi, adik! Dan semuanya!

column1: Are you the keys that can open the 'door'—?
column2: Apa kalian kunci yang bisa membuka 'pintu' itu—?

column1: (Fully resisting the pressure exerted by the two young girls, Ateraxis regrouped and lunged at Helena.)
column2: (Sambil sepenuhnya menahan tekanan dari kedua gadis kecil itu, Ateraxis menata diri dan menerkam Helena.)

column1: (Her body was indeed a bit sluggish, but her forward dash speed was still enough to break the sound barrier.)
column2: (Tubuhnya memang agak lamban, tapi kecepatan terjangannya masih cukup untuk menembus penghalang suara.)

column1: (But at the same time, a blast wall separated her from the target, the timing was absolutely flawless.)
column2: (Tapi di saat bersamaan, sebuah dinding ledak memisahkannya dari sasaran, dengan waktu yang benar-benar sempurna.)

column1: (Ateraxis casually turned to one side, which was also within the opponent's calculations. Another blast wall rose, and she swung her sword to cleave it like cutting butter, only to see a rocket appear before her eyes. The impact forced her to stagger a step, falling into the Dolls' next wave of attacks.)
column2: (Ateraxis santai berbelok ke satu sisi, dan itu pun sudah masuk perhitungan lawan. Satu dinding ledak lagi naik, dan dia mengayunkan pedangnya membelahnya semudah memotong mentega, hanya untuk melihat sebuah roket muncul di depan matanya. Hantamannya memaksanya terhuyung selangkah, jatuh ke dalam gelombang serangan para Doll berikutnya.)

column1: Jojo, breath—
column2: Jojo, semburan—

column1: (As if two chess players called out their next move at the same time, the dragon turned its head out of the net, accumulating the heat of a breath in its mouth, while the red rabbit-eared Doll cursed and ran towards the deck, lunging at the catapult switch.)
column2: (Seolah dua pemain catur menyerukan langkah berikutnya bersamaan, sang naga menjulurkan kepalanya keluar dari jaring, menghimpun panas semburan di mulutnya, sementara Doll bertelinga kelinci merah itu mengumpat dan berlari ke geladak, menerjang ke sakelar pelontar.)

column1: (The net trapping Graurizard was connected to a catapult powered by deflagrating air.)
column2: (Jaring yang memerangkap Graurizard itu tersambung ke pelontar bertenaga ledakan udara.)

column1: Fly for me!
column2: Terbang sana!

column1: (At the same time, with an unwilling roar, Ateraxis noticed that Graurizard was catapulted off The Elmo, and the bombs loaded on the capture net burst into flames one after another behind The Elmo. Although it couldn't kill the giant dragon, in a short time, the continuously wounded creature could no longer catch up with the speeding base vehicle.)
column2: (Di saat bersamaan, diiringi raungan penuh keengganan, Ateraxis melihat Graurizard terlontar keluar dari Elmo, dan bom-bom yang dipasang di jaring penangkap itu meledak berapi satu per satu di belakang Elmo. Meski tak sanggup membunuh naga raksasa itu, dalam waktu singkat makhluk yang terus terluka itu tak lagi bisa menyusul kendaraan markas yang melaju kencang.)

column1: It seems I need to take care of you first.
column2: Sepertinya aku harus mengurus kalian dulu.

column1: (With a wave of her slender fingers, spears made of Boojum shot towards Nemesis like raindrops—only a few of them accurately locked onto the target. The Dolls stood motionless in place, destroying the spears that would have hit with dense fire. Nemesis just bent down, protecting Helena and Melanie with her body, letting the other spears brush past her and explode on the bulkhead of The Elmo behind.)
column2: (Dengan lambaian jemarinya yang ramping, tombak-tombak dari Boojum melesat ke arah Nemesis bagai butir hujan—hanya beberapa yang benar-benar mengunci sasaran. Para Doll berdiri diam di tempat, menghancurkan tombak yang akan mengenai dengan tembakan rapat. Nemesis hanya membungkuk, melindungi Helena dan Melanie dengan tubuhnya, membiarkan tombak lain menyerempetnya dan meledak di sekat Elmo di belakang.)

column1: —How about this!
column2: —Bagaimana dengan ini!

column1: (Compressing the energy previously used to form a protective shield, Ateraxis released a wide-area shockwave.)
column2: (Dengan memampatkan energi yang tadi dipakai membentuk perisai pelindung, Ateraxis melepaskan gelombang kejut berarea luas.)

column1: (But the Dolls dodged the attack almost at the same time she acted, and the opportunistic firepower forced her to maintain the energy shield to block all the bullets.)
column2: (Tapi para Doll mengelak nyaris bersamaan dengan gerakannya, dan tembakan yang memanfaatkan celah itu memaksanya mempertahankan perisai energinya untuk menahan semua peluru.)

column1: —It seems I can't do this before taking care of you.
column2: —Sepertinya aku tidak bisa melakukan ini sebelum mengurusmu.

column1: (The gazes of Caldwell's first and last creations met. Ateraxis's eyes burned with the fiery heat of amusement like the sun. Nemesis's eyes were as clear as the night sky, hiding the fierce turbulence within.)
column2: (Tatapan ciptaan pertama dan terakhir Caldwell bertemu. Mata Ateraxis membara oleh panas rasa senang bagai matahari. Mata Nemesis sebening langit malam, menyembunyikan gejolak dahsyat di dalamnya.)

column1: (Ateraxis didn't rush over. Even though Melanie and Helena, those two petite girls, were draining her life every minute and every second, she didn't show the slightest urgency.)
column2: (Ateraxis tidak buru-buru menerjang. Meski Melanie dan Helena, dua gadis mungil itu, menguras kehidupannya tiap menit dan tiap detik, dia sedikit pun tidak menunjukkan ketergesaan.)

column1: (—Because she knew that Nemesis was the same.)
column2: (—Karena dia tahu Nemesis pun begitu.)

column1: (In order to respond to any action she might take at any time, the silver-haired Doll also remained motionless, but Ateraxis could see that her Frame was heating up—high-intensity computing was abnormally consuming energy, and perhaps also burning her Neural cloud.)
column2: (Demi bisa menjawab tindakan apa pun yang mungkin dia ambil kapan saja, Doll berambut perak itu pun tetap diam tak bergerak, tapi Ateraxis bisa melihat Frame-nya memanas—komputasi berintensitas tinggi menguras energi secara tidak wajar, dan mungkin juga membakar Neural cloud-nya.)

column1: (The Doll in front of her would definitely fall before she did.)
column2: (Doll di depannya pasti akan tumbang lebih dulu daripada dirinya.)

column1: Can you see it?
column2: Kau bisa melihatnya?

column1: In all the possibilities, how many times will I fail?
column2: Dari semua kemungkinan yang ada, berapa kali aku akan gagal?

column1: Hey.
column2: Hei.

column1: (The sudden cold voice made Ateraxis look sideways. A Doll wearing red rabbit ears approached her, carrying a knife.)
column2: (Suara dingin yang tiba-tiba itu membuat Ateraxis menoleh. Seorang Doll bertelinga kelinci merah mendekatinya sambil membawa pisau.)

column1: I see... I see, Commander...
column2: Aku paham... aku paham, Komandan...

column1: From the very beginning, you never had the foolish plan of wanting to defeat me head-on.
column2: Sejak awal, kau tidak pernah punya rencana bodoh untuk mengalahkanku secara frontal.

column1: You are just... maximizing the potential of an 'ordinary person'.
column2: Kau cuma... memaksimalkan potensi seorang 'manusia biasa'.

column1: That is all.
column2: Itu saja.

column1: (—She revealed a smile.)
column2: (—Dia menyunggingkan senyum.)

column1: (That wasn't mockery towards a desperately struggling mayfly, nor was it bitterness born from her own misjudgment.)
column2: (Itu bukan ejekan pada capung sehari yang meronta putus asa, bukan pula kepahitan karena salah menilai.)

column1: (It was a pure, heartfelt joy.)
column2: (Itu sukacita yang murni, dari lubuk hati.)

column1: The way you speak is even more abstract than those pig-headed Generation 3 Dolls.
column2: Cara bicaramu bahkan lebih abstrak daripada Doll Generasi 3 yang kepala batu itu.

column1: This is The Elmo, not a place where you can run wild!
column2: Ini Elmo, bukan tempat kau bisa mengamuk sesukamu!

column1: What a simple, what a pure will.
column2: Betapa sederhana, betapa murni kehendak itu.

column1: But what's the point of this?
column2: Tapi apa gunanya ini?

column1: It's very meaningful, for example, it can kill you.
column2: Sangat berguna, misalnya, ini bisa membunuhmu.

column1: (Not knowing what kind of trap the Commander had laid under the Prophet's instructions, she didn't intend to take unnecessary risks.)
column2: (Karena tidak tahu jebakan seperti apa yang dipasang Komandan atas arahan sang Peramal, dia tidak berniat mengambil risiko yang tak perlu.)

column1: (After all, even if she doesn't move, even if Helen and the others continuously reduce the vitality of the Boojum cells, she won't fail.)
column2: (Lagi pula, sekalipun dia diam saja, sekalipun Helen dan yang lain terus menggerus daya hidup sel Boojum-nya, dia tidak akan gagal.)

column1: (--Ateraxis planned this way, until she realized that this might also be the future Nemesis saw.)
column2: (--Begitulah rencana Ateraxis, sampai dia sadar bahwa itu pun mungkin masa depan yang dilihat Nemesis.)

column1: (Under the dense fire, Ateraxis didn't notice the Dolls approaching her from behind two blast walls—it wasn't to restrict her movements, but actually to restrict her from perceiving their intentions.)
column2: (Di bawah hujan tembakan yang rapat, Ateraxis tidak menyadari para Doll yang mendekatinya dari balik dua dinding ledak—itu bukan untuk membatasi geraknya, melainkan untuk membatasi kemampuannya membaca niat mereka.)

column1: (The beautifully dressed Doll bypassed the shield and grabbed Ateraxis's right arm. Despite her seemingly petite figure, she seemed to have wrist strength comparable to Voymastina's. Ateraxis dropped her long sword, dug through the other's chest with her other hand, and directly destroyed her core.)
column2: (Doll berbusana indah itu melewati perisai dan mencengkeram lengan kanan Ateraxis. Meski tubuhnya tampak mungil, kekuatan pergelangannya seakan setara Voymastina. Ateraxis menjatuhkan pedang panjangnya, menembus dada lawan dengan tangannya yang lain, dan langsung menghancurkan intinya.)

column1: (But another Doll presses forward. Ateraxis dismantles her in half a second, but the entanglement between the two Dolls is so tight that when OTs-14's giant cannon points at Ateraxis, she can only put up a hasty defense.)
column2: (Tapi satu Doll lagi mendesak maju. Ateraxis mencabiknya dalam setengah detik, tapi belitan kedua Doll itu begitu erat sehingga saat meriam raksasa OTs-14 mengarah padanya, dia hanya sempat memasang pertahanan seadanya.)

column1: (The cannon roars, and Ateraxis slides backward. She remains completely unscathed, facing the fourth Doll rushing at her—wearing red rabbit ears, with fierce anger burning in her eyes.)
column2: (Meriam itu meraung, dan Ateraxis terdorong mundur. Dia tetap sama sekali tak terluka, menghadapi Doll keempat yang menerjang ke arahnya—bertelinga kelinci merah, dengan amarah membara di matanya.)

column1: Can you still be smug?
column2: Masih bisa jumawa?

column1: (She threw herself at Ateraxis regardless of her own safety, grabbed her, and crashed into an armored vehicle.)
column2: (Dia menghambur ke arah Ateraxis tanpa peduli keselamatannya sendiri, mencengkeramnya, dan menghantam sebuah kendaraan lapis baja.)

column1: (The petite Doll, having hidden inside the vehicle early on, stepped on the accelerator, speeding down from the Elmo with Ateraxis and Krolik. Ateraxis kicked open the outer door, but the high-speed armored vehicle began to roll the moment it hit the ground. Her senses, scrambled by Helena and Melanie, hadn't yet fully recovered.)
column2: (Doll mungil yang sejak tadi bersembunyi di dalam kendaraan itu menginjak pedal gas, melesat turun dari Elmo bersama Ateraxis dan Krolik. Ateraxis menendang pintu luarnya terbuka, tapi kendaraan lapis baja berkecepatan tinggi itu mulai terguling begitu menghantam tanah. Indranya yang dikacaukan Helena dan Melanie belum sepenuhnya pulih.)

column1: (In a near-weightless state, the Doll with red bunny ears swung her blade. Ateraxis raised her arms to block the edge, snapped the opponent's wrist, and immediately punched through Krolik's chest.)
column2: (Dalam keadaan nyaris tanpa bobot, Doll bertelinga kelinci merah itu mengayunkan bilahnya. Ateraxis mengangkat lengannya menahan mata pisau itu, mematahkan pergelangan lawannya, dan langsung meninju tembus dada Krolik.)

column1: (The silver-haired Doll smiled fearlessly.)
column2: (Doll berambut perak itu tersenyum tanpa gentar.)

column1: You deserve it.
column2: Rasakan itu.

column1: (Realizing the problem, Ateraxis suddenly turned around. Before her eyes was the resolute gaze of the black-haired Doll girl, and dozens of bombs tied with Collapse crystals scattered inside the vehicle.)
column2: (Menyadari masalahnya, Ateraxis tiba-tiba berbalik. Di depan matanya ada tatapan teguh gadis Doll berambut hitam itu, dan puluhan bom yang diikat dengan kristal Collapse berserakan di dalam kendaraan.)

column1: (Ateraxis's expression changes for the first time today, and then, there is an explosion.)
column2: (Ekspresi Ateraxis berubah untuk pertama kalinya hari itu, dan kemudian, terjadilah ledakan.)

column1: (Within the confined space, a custom-made bomb detonates violently. Pure white intense heat swallows Ateraxis's field of vision, consuming the small armored vehicle and the other two Dolls as well.)
column2: (Di dalam ruang tertutup itu, bom rakitan khusus meledak dahsyat. Panas menyengat seputih murni menelan pandangan Ateraxis, melalap kendaraan lapis baja kecil itu berikut kedua Doll lainnya.)

column1: (A few minutes later.)
column2: (Beberapa menit kemudian.)

column1: Is this... the Commander's tactic? Bold, rough, and very effective... As expected of the Commander.
column2: Apa ini... taktik Komandan? Berani, kasar, dan sangat efektif... Memang beda Komandan.

column1: If there were completely thorough preparations and another battalion of Dolls at their disposal, I really would be in some danger!
column2: Kalau persiapannya benar-benar matang dan ada satu batalion Doll lagi yang bisa dikerahkan, aku benar-benar akan berada dalam bahaya!

column1: ...It's really a pity to interrupt like this.
column2: ...Sayang sekali harus terpotong begini.

column1: (Although surrounded by scorching scorched earth, she elegantly adjusted her dress, with a blush of unfaded residual heat on her face, murmuring to herself as if falling in first love.)
column2: (Meski dikelilingi tanah hangus yang membara, dia merapikan gaunnya dengan anggun, dengan rona sisa panas yang belum memudar di wajahnya, bergumam sendiri seolah sedang jatuh cinta untuk pertama kali.)

column1: But "Mother" is really mean.
column2: Tapi "Ibu" jahat sekali.

column1: A child named Helena can do such things, the other third-generation Doll "sisters" can't play nicely with the Commander.
column2: Anak bernama Helena bisa melakukan hal seperti itu, sementara "saudari" Doll generasi ketiga yang lain tidak bisa bermain baik-baik dengan Komandan.

column1: (She lifts her head and looks in the direction where The Elmo disappeared.)
column2: (Dia mendongak dan menatap ke arah lenyapnya Elmo.)

column1: (The base vehicle's track prints wind forward on the sandy ground, stretching out to a distance beyond her sight.)
column2: (Jejak roda rantai kendaraan markas itu berkelok maju di atas tanah berpasir, membentang sampai jarak yang melampaui pandangannya.)

column1: (Their psalm is still far from its end.)
column2: (Mazmur mereka masih jauh dari akhir.)

column1: Jojo, no need to rush.
column2: Jojo, tidak perlu buru-buru.

column1: (The sound of Graurizard breaking free from its restraints came from afar. To her hearing, it couldn't be clearer.)
column2: (Suara Graurizard melepaskan diri dari ikatannya terdengar dari kejauhan. Bagi pendengarannya, itu terdengar sangat jelas.)

column1: I'm looking forward to it even more.
column2: Aku jadi makin menantikannya.

column1: The next time we meet... I want to see what the scenery in your eyes looks like.
column2: Lain kali kita bertemu... aku ingin melihat seperti apa pemandangan di matamu.

column1: (She lifted her skirt and strode towards Graurizard's direction.)
column2: (Dia mengangkat ujung roknya dan melangkah lebar ke arah Graurizard.)

column1: (Behind her, the sand gradually buried the traces of the battle.)
column2: (Di belakangnya, pasir perlahan mengubur jejak-jejak pertempuran itu.)

column1: (But she remembers them.)
column2: (Tapi dia mengingatnya.)

column1: (She remembers every bullet fired at her.)
column2: (Dia mengingat setiap peluru yang ditembakkan ke arahnya.)

column1: (Those bullets are also—the traces left behind by vibrant lives.)
column2: (Peluru-peluru itu pun—jejak yang ditinggalkan kehidupan yang berdenyut.)

column1: (On The Elmo.)
column2: (Di Elmo.)

column1: Mayling, I've confirmed that the enemy is no longer pursuing us.
column2: Mayling, aku sudah memastikan musuh tidak lagi mengejar kita.

column1: As expected of the defense plan formulated by the Commander and Nemesis... That being said, that Ateraxis is way too strong, waaah!
column2: Memang beda rencana pertahanan yang disusun Komandan dan Nemesis... Meski begitu, Ateraxis itu kuat banget, waaah!

column1: And Krolik, Sakura, Lewis, Sabrina, and Voymastina all fought their hardest to buy us time...
column2: Dan Krolik, Sakura, Lewis, Sabrina, serta Voymastina semuanya bertempur mati-matian untuk membelikan kita waktu...

column1: Nemesis, what's wrong?
column2: Nemesis, ada apa?

column1: (Everyone turned their heads and looked at Nemesis, who had originally been protecting Melanie and Helena, but was now kneeling quietly on the ground.)
column2: (Semua orang menoleh dan menatap Nemesis, yang tadinya melindungi Melanie dan Helena, tapi kini berlutut diam di lantai.)

column1: (Her eyes were as blurry as melted silver. Mayling was about to reach out to help her up, but was stopped by a quiet, faint voice.)
column2: (Matanya buram bagai perak yang meleleh. Mayling hendak mengulurkan tangan membantunya berdiri, tapi dihentikan oleh suara pelan yang nyaris tak terdengar.)

column1: Don't touch... my Frame is very hot right now.
column2: Jangan disentuh... Frame-ku sedang sangat panas.

column1: (She lifts her gaze, staring at the sky with a sorrowful smile.)
column2: (Dia mengangkat pandangannya, menatap langit dengan senyum yang muram.)

column1: At least, there's still time to say goodbye to everyone...
column2: Setidaknya, masih ada waktu untuk berpamitan pada semuanya...

column1: Farewell!? Are you... is something going to happen to you?
column2: Berpamitan!? Apa kau... apa akan terjadi sesuatu padamu?

column1: (Nemesis shook her head, and Groza noticed tears glistening in her eyes.)
column2: (Nemesis menggeleng, dan Groza melihat air mata berkilau di matanya.)

column1: As long as it's not completely destroyed, it will slowly be repaired... Although it doesn't have Boojum cells, this Frame is special... given to her by that man... Right, I haven't told the Commander yet, this Frame is prepared by the URNC...
column2: Selama tidak hancur total, ia akan pulih perlahan... Meski tidak punya sel Boojum, Frame ini istimewa... diberikan padanya oleh pria itu... Oh iya, aku belum memberitahu Komandan, Frame ini disiapkan oleh URNC...

column1: No... it's nothing...
column2: Tidak... bukan apa-apa...

column1: Captain, now, please take Helen and the others to the control room.
column2: Kapten, sekarang, tolong bawa Helen dan yang lain ke ruang kendali.

column1: So that... the Commander can... return... please make sure to protect these two children...
column2: Supaya... Komandan bisa... kembali... tolong pastikan kedua anak ini dilindungi...

column1: Return...? Is the Commander going somewhere?
column2: Kembali...? Memangnya Komandan akan pergi ke suatu tempat?

column1: I have no way to interpret destiny, this is just my feeling...
column2: Aku tidak punya cara menafsirkan takdir, ini cuma perasaanku...

column1: Going to a very, very far place... my beloved lighthouse, the light of my life... went to a future I cannot see...
column2: Pergi ke tempat yang sangat, sangat jauh... mercusuarku tercinta, cahaya hidupku... pergi ke masa depan yang tak bisa kulihat...

column1: But it's okay, it's okay... the stars and the moon will protect the Commander...
column2: Tapi tidak apa-apa, tidak apa-apa... bintang dan bulan akan melindungi Komandan...

column1: Elif will properly... wait for the Commander to return.
column2: Elif akan dengan setia... menunggu Komandan kembali.

column1: (Nemesis murmured a few words and slowly fell forward. Groza quickly supported her.)
column2: (Nemesis menggumamkan beberapa patah kata lalu perlahan roboh ke depan. Groza cepat menopangnya.)

column1: (With the physical contact, Groza's skin emitted white smoke due to the high temperature. She carefully checked Nemesis's condition without any hesitation and raised her head.)
column2: (Begitu bersentuhan, kulit Groza mengepulkan asap putih karena suhu yang tinggi. Dia tetap memeriksa kondisi Nemesis dengan cermat tanpa ragu sedikit pun, lalu mendongak.)

column1: It's fine... She likely just temporarily powered down due to overheating.
column2: Tidak apa-apa... Sepertinya dia cuma mati sementara karena kepanasan.

column1: And Nemesis's suggestion...
column2: Dan saran Nemesis...

column1: Colphne, please execute Nemesis's instructions immediately.
column2: Colphne, tolong segera jalankan instruksi Nemesis.

column1: Okay!
column2: Baik!

column1: Also, once the temperature returns to normal, Mayling, please check Nemesis's Frame.
column2: Lalu, begitu suhunya kembali normal, Mayling, tolong periksa Frame Nemesis.

column1: Nemesis's Frame is very special and must be treated with caution.
column2: Frame Nemesis sangat istimewa dan harus ditangani dengan hati-hati.

column1: Finally, once we confirm that we have left the enemy's pursuit range, we must find a way to... recover Voymastina's Frame.
column2: Terakhir, begitu kita pastikan sudah keluar dari jangkauan kejar musuh, kita harus mencari cara untuk... mengambil kembali Frame Voymastina.

column1: Mayling, is everything normal?
column2: Mayling, semuanya normal?

column1: Aside from Ateraxis just now, no suspicious signs have been found so far.
column2: Selain Ateraxis tadi, sejauh ini belum ditemukan tanda-tanda mencurigakan.

column1: But... there is one thing I'm concerned about.
column2: Tapi... ada satu hal yang mengganjal pikiranku.

column1: Since The Elmo left Mokosh, I turned off all radios on the vehicle and at the same time turned the signal jamming system to maximum stealth mode...
column2: Sejak Elmo meninggalkan Mokosh, aku mematikan semua radio di kendaraan dan sekaligus menyetel sistem pengacau sinyal ke mode siluman maksimal...

column1: How exactly did the enemy lock onto our position?
column2: Bagaimana persisnya musuh bisa mengunci posisi kita?

column1: And I heard the Commander say that The Elmo uses equipment from ten years ago...
column2: Dan kudengar Komandan bilang Elmo memakai perlengkapan dari sepuluh tahun lalu...

column1: Could it be that the military upgraded their reconnaissance system, so they found a way to break through our blockade?
column2: Mungkinkah militer meningkatkan sistem pengintaian mereka, sehingga menemukan cara menembus blokade kita?

column1: However, even so... it can't explain why the other party came so fast...
column2: Tapi sekalipun begitu... itu tidak menjelaskan kenapa mereka datang secepat itu...

column1: Indeed... could it be that something leaked our coordinates...
column2: Benar juga... jangan-jangan ada sesuatu yang membocorkan koordinat kita...

column1: But... this kind of situation has never happened before.
column2: Tapi... situasi semacam ini belum pernah terjadi sebelumnya.

column1: Right, could it be—!
column2: Iya, jangan-jangan—!

column1: ...The one sent to The Elmo before...!
column2: ...Benda yang dulu dikirim ke Elmo...!

column1: (The silver-haired woman in military uniform stood in the command room, gazing into the depths of this desert—this place filled with collapse radiation everywhere.)
column2: (Perempuan berambut perak berseragam militer itu berdiri di ruang komando, menatap jauh ke dalam gurun ini—tempat yang dipenuhi radiasi collapse di mana-mana.)

column1: (She coughed symbolically a few times.)
column2: (Dia berdeham beberapa kali sekadar formalitas.)

column1: (Just now, some indescribably complex feeling climbed into her thoughts.)
column2: (Barusan, semacam perasaan rumit yang sulit dijelaskan merayap ke dalam pikirannya.)

column1: (Many cities were once born here, but now only endless desolation remains.)
column2: (Banyak kota pernah lahir di sini, tapi kini hanya tersisa kesunyian tanpa ujung.)

column1: (To breed anything that could be called 'life' in this barren wasteland could be considered a miraculous existence.)
column2: (Bisa melahirkan apa pun yang layak disebut 'kehidupan' di tanah tandus ini sudah bisa dianggap keberadaan yang ajaib.)

column1: (And she used to have a very keen interest in these miracles.)
column2: (Dan dia dulu punya minat yang sangat besar pada keajaiban-keajaiban semacam itu.)

column1: General, 'that lady' has sent the coordinates.
column2: Jenderal, 'nona itu' sudah mengirimkan koordinatnya.

column1: The 'secret weapon' you deployed is fully charged and ready to activate at any time.
column2: 'Senjata rahasia' yang Anda gelar sudah terisi penuh dan siap diaktifkan kapan saja.

column1: (Anjelie withdrew her thoughts.)
column2: (Anjelie menarik kembali lamunannya.)

column1: (Right now, she still has very important 'work' to do.)
column2: (Saat ini, dia masih punya 'pekerjaan' yang sangat penting.)

column1: (That is—to defeat that mobile fortress moving rapidly in the Yellow Zone, trying to shake off pursuit.)
column2: (Yaitu—mengalahkan benteng bergerak yang melaju kencang di Yellow Zone itu, yang berusaha melepaskan diri dari pengejaran.)

column1: (She doesn't have much time. Because based on her understanding of that Commander, he has very likely already discovered that lady's little trick.)
column2: (Waktunya tidak banyak. Sebab berdasarkan pemahamannya tentang Komandan itu, orang tersebut kemungkinan besar sudah menemukan trik kecil sang nona.)

column1: Target confirmed—this operation is a pursuit against the URNC's special wanted criminal, the famous 'Commander'.
column2: Sasaran terkonfirmasi—operasi ini adalah pengejaran terhadap buronan khusus URNC, sang 'Komandan' yang termasyhur itu.

column1: Confirming strike target again: The Elmo.
column2: Menegaskan kembali sasaran gempuran: Elmo.

column1: Target confirmed.
column2: Sasaran terkonfirmasi.

column1: Cut off power supply to all non-combat modules of the power supply device, and focus all energy to the main gun array.
column2: Putus pasokan daya ke seluruh modul non-tempur pada perangkat catu daya, dan pusatkan seluruh energi ke larik meriam utama.

column1: Energy focusing complete.
column2: Pemusatan energi selesai.

column1: For the next minute, do not accept any external communication requests.
column2: Selama satu menit ke depan, jangan terima permintaan komunikasi dari luar.

column1: The final safety lock is beginning to disengage.
column2: Kunci pengaman terakhir mulai dilepas.

column1: ('Beep—' 'Beep—' 'Beep—')
column2: ('Bip—' 'Bip—' 'Bip—')

column1: (The alarm for the disengagement of the safety lock continuously echoed in Anjelie's ears.)
column2: (Sirene pelepasan kunci pengaman itu terus bergema di telinga Anjelie.)

column1: (Her gaze remained fixed on the flickering red circle on the radar panel.)
column2: (Pandangannya tetap terpaku pada lingkaran merah yang berkedip di panel radar.)

column1: Safety lock disengaged.
column2: Kunci pengaman terlepas.

column1: Final thirty seconds countdown.
column2: Hitung mundur tiga puluh detik terakhir.

column1: All personnel wear anti-glare goggles.
column2: Seluruh personel kenakan kacamata anti-silau.

column1: (Everyone in the command room picked up their goggles.)
column2: (Semua orang di ruang komando mengambil kacamata mereka.)

column1: (Anjelie's goggles were right by her hand, but at this moment she seemed to have neglected this, just continuing to stare intently at The Elmo's moving direction.)
column2: (Kacamata Anjelie ada tepat di sisi tangannya, tapi saat itu dia seakan mengabaikannya, hanya terus menatap lekat arah pergerakan Elmo.)

column1: Energy injection reached standard.
column2: Injeksi energi mencapai standar.

column1: Continuously tracking strike target.
column2: Terus melacak sasaran gempuran.

column1: Final firing angle confirmation.
column2: Konfirmasi akhir sudut tembak.

column1: (Anjelie's lips spat out a cold command.)
column2: (Bibir Anjelie melontarkan perintah yang dingin.)

column1: (In her pupils, only that constantly flashing dot of light trying to break free from the radar search remained.)
column2: (Di pupilnya hanya tersisa titik cahaya yang terus berkedip, berusaha lepas dari penyisiran radar.)

column1: ...Fire.
column2: ...Tembak.

column1: (The dust kicked up by the explosion slowly dissipated, and Ateraxis's figure finally reappeared.)
column2: (Debu yang diterbangkan ledakan itu perlahan sirna, dan sosok Ateraxis akhirnya muncul kembali.)

column1: (The huge energy released after the Collapse Piece was detonated indeed caused effective damage to this powerful body—Ateraxis, whose injuries used to heal instantly, was actually still slowly recovering at this moment, with a few burn scars still remaining on her exposed skin.)
column2: (Energi besar yang dilepaskan setelah Collapse Piece itu diledakkan memang menimbulkan kerusakan efektif pada tubuh yang perkasa ini—Ateraxis, yang lukanya biasanya sembuh seketika, saat itu justru masih pulih perlahan, dengan beberapa bekas luka bakar masih tersisa di kulitnya yang terbuka.)

column1: (Ateraxis exclaimed in surprise, but without a trace of real panic. She just stood leisurely in the ashes, holding a pair of charred red rabbit ears in her hand, seemingly unable to put them down.)
column2: (Ateraxis berseru kaget, tapi tanpa secuil pun panik yang sungguhan. Dia hanya berdiri santai di atas abu, menggenggam sepasang telinga kelinci merah yang hangus di tangannya, seakan tak sanggup melepaskannya.)
